blocks.html:
One corridor, one useful apparel page

Northgate and InterQuest apparel projects need a clear brief

Northgate and InterQuest form a connected north Colorado Springs corridor with a mix of commercial, entertainment, event, hospitality, and service activity. Rather than splitting that overlap into two thin location pages, this page focuses on the planning decisions an apparel project in the corridor actually needs.

Whether the request is for branded staff pieces, an event run, a promotional campaign, or merchandise, ARK starts with the artwork, garment needs, quantity, print locations, and deadline. That creates a more useful quote than a location label alone.

A corridor page built for real use cases

Three Northgate + InterQuest programs to organize

These examples describe apparel planning and do not assert a relationship with any area business, venue, employer, or event.

01 · STAFF

Customer-facing staff apparel

For a unified team look, specify the logo treatment, garment requirements, size range, role variations, and how the program should handle future additions.

02 · PROMOTE

Campaign and event apparel

A campaign tee or event garment needs a deadline, design direction, print locations, expected quantity, and a clear handoff or distribution plan.

03 · SELL

Promotional merchandise

For a public-facing product, include the target buyer, garment preference, visual coverage, launch quantity, and whether this is a test or recurring run.

Control the moving parts

Send a Northgate + InterQuest quote with the right context

The most helpful quote requests connect the creative direction to the way the garments will actually be used and distributed.

  • Logo, design file, or campaign direction
  • Garment category and colors
  • Quantity, sizing, and any multiple audience groups
  • Print locations and personalization needs
  • Campaign, opening, event, or in-hands date

Quote-first workflow

How a north-corridor apparel program progresses

  1. Submit the project scope through the quote form.
  2. ARK assesses the artwork, garment, quantity, and production considerations.
  3. The quote and artwork-proofing path are defined before the order is scheduled.
  4. The approved project is printed in Colorado Springs and fulfillment details are coordinated.

Choose the finish after the brief

Choose the method based on the program—not the corridor

The right production method follows the artwork and usage: a recurring staff program, full-color promo piece, and detailed merchandise design can each call for a different solution. Use the quote to compare the practical choices.

Use the quote form to describe the project. These service pages can help you understand the production conversation before you submit it.
